name: HarnessRouter (UHP /v1/responses)
disclaimer: Written from the Universal Harness Protocol (UHP) specification and HarnessRouter source at 80d5d369a1ddf14cad8bd9cf3a1a5891d15616b6 (Apache 2.0), read 2026-11-04. Tested against a loopback UHP /v1/responses stand-in in tests/test_api_review.py; a live HarnessRouter instance is proven on a local candidate by the owner.
notes: Not a harness polyctl drives: a Tier-3 UHP tool reviewer polyctl runs over the staged candidate via polyctl-api-review --protocol uhp. Sends a single POST <base_url>/responses with {model, input, stream: false} (and metadata.harness_id when the model is written as <harness_id>/<model> or <provider>/<harness_id>/<model>) plus an Idempotency-Key header. Reads HARNESSROUTER_BASE_URL (default http://localhost:3000/api/harness/v1) and HARNESSROUTER_API_KEY, or a provider entry in review.api_providers when the model starts with <provider>/. Refuses any UHP response whose metadata.model_fallback is true or whose returned model differs from the requested model so cross-family reviewer independence cannot silently degrade.

roles.reviewer: eligible: one UHP POST /v1/responses completion over the review prompt through polyctl's stdlib client, refusing silent model fallback
roles.implementer: ineligible: UHP runs inside a remote harness container rather than this repository's working tree
roles.architect: ineligible: it answers one review request and keeps no local session store

send.note: The prompt carries the candidate's diff; the diff file is the same bytes, handed as every tool reviewer is handed them.

stdin.note: A prompt past what one argument carries is read from standard input: polyctl-api-review takes - for it.

options.trust_none_note: nothing to deny locally: polyctl runs polyctl-api-review outside any repository over the diff file it wrote, and UHP reserves the client tools field on /v1/responses
options.model_note: [<provider>/][<harness_id>/]<model>: uses HARNESSROUTER_BASE_URL (default http://localhost:3000/api/harness/v1) and HARNESSROUTER_API_KEY, or a <provider> named in review.api_providers; when <harness_id> is given (e.g. claude-code/claude-sonnet-4-6), sends metadata.harness_id in the UHP request
options.effort_note: polyctl composes no effort for a tool

environment.note: Named providers are read from the machine's own settings file: one named through POLYCTL_SETTINGS could send the review, and its key, elsewhere. HARNESSROUTER_BASE_URL is held to https or loopback by polyctl-api-review.

limits: UHP reserves the client tools field on /v1/responses because tools execute inside the server's harness container; polyctl hands harnessrouter the diff in the prompt alone
polyctl refuses a UHP response that sets metadata.model_fallback or names another model, but relies on the UHP server to report model_fallback honestly
